description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) named ProductDetailResponse, which includes nested LocalizedText records. It models detailed product information for a catalog service, primarily used for preview purposes in a gateway environment where downstream services are bypassed.

classes.name: ProductDetailResponse
classes.description: A record representing detailed product information, including IDs, type, availability, localized descriptions, and timestamps.

classes.name: LocalizedText
classes.description: A nested record within ProductDetailResponse that contains localization-specific data such as language ID, name, description, and URL slug.
